storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content: Tawil does not exist in the current world. Their existence would draw the attention of the 'Supreme Will,' so They cannot and must not exist. Wisdom and silence are all The Gatekeeper can offer to these tireless seekers. In Their daily vigil, Tawil quietly bestows Their wisdom, courage, and silent blessings upon the fate of humanity.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
In a mysterious dream, I first saw Them.

In an endless and foggy space, They guarded a majestic and eternal Gate linking countless vast universes. Beyond the deep cracks of the Gate, strange illusions flickered like undeciphered signals. Upon catching a signal, I felt my body vanish, aimlessly floating among the stars, enshrouded by an incredible darkness. I was terrified; the dream violently shook, the heavy Gate irresistibly opening, with countless sphere-like objects shining like stars beyond it. The vast and unfathomable scene made me dizzy... and the Gate's guardian—Tawil—silently and eternally watched me.

—Ward Phillips, Silver Key Notes

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Tawil has manifested in Mythag only three times.

The first time, Tawil ignited the spark of "Wisdom." The Gatekeeper opened the passage to dream, imparting rare Knowledge to the ignorant founders of Mythag. They provided Mythag's original "think tank," along with clues and insights about Dissolution.

The second time, Tawil delivered the prophecy of "Change." The Black Pool churned, welcoming the Arrival of the one who would "Transform" the world.

The third time, They transmitted the signal of "Finale." Their cries and wails resonated across the earth, yet could not prevent the inevitable descent of Chaos and Destruction.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Kadath is not the only dream Tawil seeks to protect.

The Gatekeeper has witnessed the birth and destruction of countless planets and galaxies, with the histories of past and future sedimented into knowledge, absorbed into the Ultimate Gate behind Them. With a gaze full of compassion, Tawil looks down upon these scenes, which dissolve into fleeting glimpses in Their dreams, vanishing into the darkness of the boundless abyss.

Tawil once stepped onto a piece of land, but in the moment They glanced back, everything They cherished crumbled beneath the breath of the "Supreme Will."

After endless repetitions, They finally realized a harsh truth: Their very existence serves as the prelude to a nightmare; Their immense presence alone draws the gaze of the "Supreme Will." Their interference would only bring deeper misfortune to the world They hold dear.

Thus, Tawil retreated. Tawil fell silent.

Until They perceived a glimmer of change emanating from "It" within the drifting fragments of consciousness in the infinite expanse...

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content: As the Aeon of Sagacity's Proxy and Gatekeeper, Tawil has not lacked the desire to explore Their own essence. Tawil yearns to walk the earth like those The Gatekeeper watches over, witnessing the changes in civilization and the vicissitudes of history, gathering all They see into a treasury called 'Omniscience.' But Their existence does not allow Them to abandon Their post. Deep in Tawil's heart, perhaps what They envy most is the girl who carries a thread of Their will...

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: Directly linking with an Aeon will damage your mind. However, since you insist, I will respond to your call.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: A fragment from the infinite space-time continuum arrives within my awareness.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: Visit Their dream and glimpse the universe's forbidden secrets.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: Do not let Their knowledge and memories be wasted.

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: The First Gate. The infinite universe was born from a point.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: The Second Gate. A line extends from a point, stretching toward infinite polarities.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: The Third Gate. Planes are partial and one-sided constructs.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: The Fourth Gate. The eternal archetype solidified in a space of dimensions.

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: The Fifth Gate. The passage of time is but an illusion; there has never been a beginning, and thus, no end.

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: The Ultimate Gate. The final void linking countless universes. Pass through it, and the mysteries of the world will be revealed to you.

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: The synchronization between us should not require such a lengthy adjustment. However, to preserve your mental clarity from the illusions, I will proceed gradually.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: I will show you my dreams. Everything bizarre and chaotic that you see is closer to the true nature of this world than the reality you know.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: Here is my advice: Remain calm. When you feel tired, stop immediately and conserve your strength. Otherwise, you will be forever lost in the dream realm.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: You have gone deep, very deep. Soon, you will witness an extraordinary miracle. I hope you can remain as sane and calm as you are now.

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: The Ultimate Gate opens for you. Embrace the world of deathly silence beyond.

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Do you wish to confirm something? The senses of this body are too restricted. If we meet in the Abyss, I can show you much more.

daily.title: Chat: About the Crisis
daily.content: It is Their will... No, it is an unconscious gaze that encompasses all things within Their breath.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: I only helped them found this institution for "Storage." The school has achieved more than I anticipated.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: I love... the "Answer." It is out of this love that I have guarded this Gate, and out of this love that I placed its Key in your hand.

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: I hate... "Ignorance." No, to diligently seek the ultimate truth is not ignorance. True ignorance lies in living in a haze, unaware of what one does not know.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: I was only meant to be your guide, leading you on this journey before returning to rest in the illusory waters. Now, you are my Linker, and our connection is so intricate it is difficult to sever.

daily.title: Chat: About Ramona
daily.content: That child has endured far too much because of the Fragment of me within her. Thankfully, her soul remains as clear as flowing silver.

daily.title: Chat: About Ramona: Timeworn
daily.content: She is a Fragment of me from another dimension that has been eternally annihilated. Sadly, while she mastered time reversal, she failed to grasp the essence of transcending spacetime, repeatedly succumbing to anguish. This is my fault.

daily.title: Chat: About Aeon of Desire
daily.content: The Aeon of Desire, Tifere Yesod, has found her path to survival. In the face of the unknown, no one can judge the nobility or baseness of her methods.

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: I failed... to see it all....

battle.title: Special Skill: II
battle.content: Listen to the voice of wisdom.

battle.title: Rouse
battle.content: Pass through the Silver Key Gate to reach Their Throne.

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: The Ultimate Gate has opened. Witness the All-in-One and One-in-All!

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: Past, present, future. A billion brilliances gather as one!
